acceptanceCriteria: Both tests pass reliably under CI shard load, for example by bounding the deadline on an injected clock or a deterministic hook instead of wall-clock timing.
A stress run at -count=20 under parallel package load shows no failures.
body: PR beamfall/corvint#1552 (lane perf-1022s, which touches only internal/tasks) failed go-product-shard 6 and 7 in run https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/actions/runs/39794835161 on two cmd/corvint deadline tests: TestWorkFinalCheckClosingContext/WQO-V0-032/deadline (work_final_check_test.go:369 'initial capture: ADAPTER_FAILED') and TestContextExpandDeadlineExpiryRefusesAsDeadlineExceeded (source_handoff_unix_test.go:271 'cat-file all: the root is not its Git toplevel, want deadline-exceeded'). Both pass -count=3 locally on the same head aaa260d44, so they are timing-sensitive under shared CI load.
title: cmd/corvint deadline tests flake under CI shard load (WQO-V0-032 deadline, context expand deadline-exceeded)
